windGrid.note: separate low-res file; wind is smooth so 4° suffices (cuts per-user transfer by 43%)

encoding.A: CWAT column cloud water kg/m², log: cwat = 10^(A/255*2.6021 + -2.3010); 0 below 0.005, 255 at 2.0
encoding.quantization: cloud PNG is grayscale+alpha; top height in 64 steps (~251 m), cloud water in 64 levels — values are not invented, only the grid of representable values is coarser (cuts frame size 330->229KB)
encoding.B: DERIVED cloud top height, metres: B/255*16000 (topmost of LCDC/MCDC/HCDC at 2200/6200/11000 m; not a GFS output field)
encoding.precip.B: DERIVED thunder likelihood = ramp(CPRAT mm/h, 0.15..2.0) × ramp(CAPE, 500..2000); not a GFS output field
encoding.wind.R: UGRD 700 hPa, m/s: R/255*128-64 (0.5 m/s quantized, 4° mean)
encoding.wind.G: VGRD 700 hPa, m/s: G/255*128-64 (0.5 m/s quantized, 4° mean)
encoding.temp: TMP 2 m above ground, grayscale 8bit linear: degC = byte*0.5-80 (-80.0..47.5, clamped)
encoding.wind10.R: UGRD 10 m above ground, m/s: R/255*128-64 (same decode as wind.R; full grid, no 4° mean, no 0.5 m/s pre-quantization)
encoding.wind10.G: VGRD 10 m above ground, m/s: G/255*128-64 (same decode as wind.G; full grid, no 4° mean, no 0.5 m/s pre-quantization)
encoding.mslp: PRMSL mean sea level, grayscale 8bit linear: hPa = byte*0.5+940 (940.0..1067.5, clamped)
encoding.apcp: APCP surface accumulated precipitation mm, log: 0 if byte==0 else 10^(byte/255*3.3979-1.0000); 0 at or below 0.1, 255 at 250. Window per step = steps[].apcpWindow (GFS 6-hour bucket: 3 h at h%6==3, 6 h at h%6==0; none at h=0)

note: 불투명도는 두께(CWAT), 높이는 층별 비율에서 유도(B=DERIVED). 구름 비율로 불투명도를 만들면 지구 절반이 90%라 베일이 된다(실측). 프레임 사이 값은 바람으로 이류한 보간이며 모델 출력이 아니다. 없는 스텝은 만들지 않았다.

temp.note: model 2 m temperature on a 0.50° cell (~56 km), not a station value

wind10.note: same decode formula as the 700 hPa wind frame (wind.R/G) but on the full grid and without the 0.5 m/s pre-quantization (max error 0.251 m/s instead of 0.5)

mslp.note: values outside the range are clamped to the end value; steps[].mslpClipped counts such cells

apcp.window: steps[].apcpWindow {fromH,toH} hours from run, read from GRIB PDT 4.8
apcp.note: GFS 6-hour bucket as delivered (resets every 6 h): 3 h at h%6==3, 6 h at h%6==0; no frame at h=0 (analysis has no accumulation). 3-hour amount at h%6==0 is a[h] - a[h-3]. The run-total APCP record is not published.

decodeStats.note: describe first, decode only what is used (NOMADS returns var × level cross product)

runsNote: newest first, up to 4 runs; manifest paths are relative to this file (like steps[].file). Runs made before schema 2 have no per-run copy and are not listed.
